key_findings: All certificates valid on all 14 table rows; block masses obey ||P_i e_x|| <= L_i(x).
Sampled sup of the transfer probability attains the ITF to 3 s.f. (K4, dimer) and 0.97 (P4).
Sigma1/S ranges from 4.3e5 (K4, k=3) to 3.0e259 (P4, k=40).
Fitted true decay rate 5.4-5.9 (K4, dimer) and 4.4 (P4) per unit distance vs certified gamma_kappa 0.8-1.4 and 0.22-0.24; Stark-ladder factorial correction halves the fit residual (suggestive).
Figure itf_vs_bounds: near g -> 2 delta+ only B_E^2 ~ 0.54 remains informative while the ITF stays at 8e-19.
summary.interpretation: The certificates are valid but conservative by many orders of magnitude on the Section 7 families; the gap is a rate gap (certified rate normalized by internal coupling, bridges seen only through eta), not an ITF-vs-F_max gap.
